FROM gcr.io/oss-fuzz-base/base-builder
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
  make flex bison libtool automake autoconf

RUN git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/jqlang/jq
WORKDIR $SRC/jq
COPY build.sh *.dict $SRC/
